# Fixture attribution

The files under `macula/` are a subset of MACULA Greek (commit `8423afe47b9e8f24b7772e808af45c7159a6fe7e`), generated by `tools/make_fixture.py`: rows and files for
Philemon, 2 John and 3 John only, with the fields of non-open components
removed (domain, ln).

- MACULA Greek Linguistic Datasets, available at https://github.com/Clear-Bible/macula-greek/ (CC-BY-4.0)
- `sblgnt-text` (CC-BY-4.0): SBL Greek New Testament (SBLGNT), copyright 2010 by the Society of Biblical Literature and Logos Bible Software, https://github.com/LogosBible/SBLGNT
- `macula-clear` (CC-BY-4.0): MACULA Greek Linguistic Datasets, available at https://github.com/Clear-Bible/macula-greek/
- `berean` (LicenseRef-PublicDomain): Berean Interlinear Bible glosses, placed in the public domain on 2023-04-30, https://interlinearbible.com/
- `cherith` (CC-BY-4.0): Cherith Glosses for the Greek New Testament, by Andi Wu, Copyright (C) 2023 by Cherith Analytics
- `marble` (excluded): Word sense data from the United Bible Societies MARBLE project, used by MACULA with permission -- EXCLUDED from this build
